items.name: La Massana 2021

venue.name: [La Closeta](https://www.lamassana.ad/serveis-equipaments/teatre-fontetes-sales-comunals)
venue.address: Av. de Sant Antoni, 29, AD400 La Massana, Andorra

items.information:
Revisa l'[horari](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LaMassana2021#competition-schedule). Allà hi trobaràs tota la planificació de la competició. Es prega molta puntualitat. Et recomanem arribar mitja hora abans de cada prova a la qual competeixis.

Llegeix detingudament la pestanya sobre la [COVID-19](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LaMassana2021#16408-covid-19) amb els principals canvis de la competició a causa de la situació sanitària.

--------

Revisa el [horario](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LaMassana2021#competition-schedule). Allí encontraràs toda la planificación de la competición. Se ruega mucha puntualidad. Te recomendamos llegar media hora antes de cada prueba en la que compitas.

Lee detenidamente la pestaña sobre el [COVID-19](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LaMassana2021#16408-covid-19) con los principales cambios de la competición debido a la situación sanitaria.

--------

Check the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LaMassana2021#competition-schedule). There you can see all the planning of the competition. Please be very punctual. We recommend you to arrive half hour in advance for each event you compete in.

Read carefully the tab about [COVID-19](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LaMassana2021#16408-covid-19) with the main changes in the competition due to the health situation.

items.name: Finnish Championship 2021
items.information:
No shoes inside the venue. There is a limit of one guest per competitor. More information on the [COVID-19 Precautions tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FinnishChampionship2021#16462-covid-19-precautions-koronavarotoimet).
Please read through the [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.
The schedule may be subject to change, so make sure to be at the venue at least 30 minutes before your scheduled events.

Ei kenkiä sisätiloissa. Yksi vieras per kilpailija. Lue lisää [Koronavarotoimet-välilehdeltä](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FinnishChampionship2021#16462-covid-19-precautions-koronavarotoimet).
Lue säännöt ([englanniksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/), [suomeksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/finnish/)) ennen kilpailua.
Aikataulu voi muuttua päivän aikana, joten ole paikalla vähintään 30 minuuttia ennen lajejasi.

venue.name: Activa Club
venue.address: Jiron Pallcamarca 501, Urb Tupac Amaru,  Independencia

items.information:
Los resultados de este torneo ingresarán a la base de datos y al ranking de la WCA, y quienes participen por primera vez adquirirán un perfil oficial. Por esa razón, todos los competidores deben conocer el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

____

The results of this competition will enter the data base and WCA ranking, and the ones participating for the first time will acquire an official profile. For that reason, every competitor must know the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

items.name: Welcome Back Wisconsin 2 2021

venue.name: Embassy Suites by Hilton Milwaukee Brookfield
venue.details: In the Ambassador Ballroom to the left of the Entrance

items.information:
# There is a limit of one guest per competitor in this competition
# YOUR REGISTRATION WILL NOT BE ACCEPTED IF YOU LIST TWO OR MORE GUESTS
There is plenty of lobby space for other people that cannot come into the venue. If you will have multiple guests but one will stay in the lobby DO NOT list multiple guests.

We will be requiring proof of a negative COVID-19 test within 96 hours of the competition or proof of full vaccination to enter the competition.

You can view our risk management plan for this competition [here](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Evh8xq1AGn6HSbTYEz8y0pynaEVhDV_w/view?usp=sharing)

items.name: Cobb Cubes Comeback 2B 2021
items.information:
# Registration has closed and the waitlist is full.

This competition is a **series competition** with [Cobb Cubes Comeback 2A 2021](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CobbCubesComeback2A2021). Please review the Series Competition tab for more information.

This competition is in the **afternoon**, competitors for this competition should arrive at noon and not before then.

Make sure to dress up and partake in our Costume Contest! Awards for podium placements will be given during the awards ceremony.

Please review the Competitor Information tab before the competition.
